coder_notes: Only intervention is an mRNA lipid-particle cancer vaccine (excluded type), so no candidate. Adult GBM stratum plus paediatric HGG stratum (mixed_age; stdAges include CHILD). 'WHO Grade IV glioma' without IDH requirement and 'de novo GBM / secondary GBM' wording -> historical. Temozolomide not a registered intervention but standard chemoradiation is stated for GBM patients (Stratum 1). Levetiracetam mentioned only as an example antiepileptic patients must be willing to take; not listed. MGMT unmethylated required for the adult cohort (enrichment); BRAF V600E+ is an exclusion for the paediatric cohort; neither candidate-matched. Detailed description also mentions recurrent medulloblastoma in the official title but no such arm is registered.
